## Ordinary-person problem / 普通人问题

Who got stuck, where, and why?

## What changed / 改了什么

Include a before/after example.

## Meaning preserved / 没有丢掉的事实

- [ ] The user's choice is still clear.
- [ ] Consequences and risks are still clear.
- [ ] The next action is clear.
- [ ] No new unexplained term replaces the old one.

## Checks / 检查

- [ ] Relevant evaluation cases were added or updated.
- [ ] Chinese/English decision parity was checked when both changed.
- [ ] No API key, token, password, private URL, personal contact detail, or customer data is included.
- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and agree to its contribution terms.
